zh.title: 臺灣虎航推虎裏轉tigerhop一站式轉機平臺
zh.summary: 臺灣虎航推一站式轉機平臺；首波與酷航合作；新加坡旅客可經臺轉日本
body: 臺灣虎航今天宣佈，推出一站式轉機服務的「虎裏轉tigerhop」訂票平臺，未來從新加坡出發的旅客，可透過臺灣轉機至臺灣虎航飛航的秋田、鳥取等航點，日本旅客亦可來臺轉機至新加坡。
臺灣虎航宣佈與旅遊科技業者Dohop簽署MOU，並從即日起推出平臺，首波與酷航（Scoot）合作，讓旅客可預訂聯航轉機合作航點的機票。平臺採用Dohop的「RetailConnect」技術。
透過平臺，新加坡出發旅客可經桃園機場自行轉機至秋田、鳥取、岡山等日本地方城市航點。臺灣虎航目前共飛航日本、韓國、泰國及越南等地區，其中日本航點高達22個。

en.title: Tigerair Taiwan launches one-stop transit booking platform 'tigerhop' with Dohop
body: Tigerair Taiwan announced today the launch of its one-stop transit service booking platform 'tigerhop Tigers'. Passengers departing from Singapore can transit via Taiwan to routes such as Akita and Tortri, while Japanese travelers can also fly via Taiwan to Singapore.

The airline announced signing a one-stop C with travel technology firm Dohop, immediately launching the platform with first partner Scroo. The platform uses Dohop's 'RetailConnect' technology to help Tigerair bypass traditional inter-airline or codes-share technical limits.
Via the platform, passengers can self- to Japanese regional airports such as Akita, Tortori, and Okamaya through on airport. The airline currently at has a network of 22 Japan destinations.
Tigerair said that ticketing through the platform does not include a bag-bag service and connects for three to 48 hours for transit.
en.summary: Tigerair Taiwan announced one-stop transit booking platform first with Scoot for routes via Taiwan
